mapper.sql: p.id AS database_id, p.business_id, p.tenant_id, p.name, p.description, p.status, p.coordinator_agent_id, p.created_by, p.created_at, p.updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO digital_team_project (business_id, tenant_id, name, description, coordinator_agent_id, status, created_by) VALUES (#{businessId}, #{tenantId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{coordinatorAgentId}, #{status}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM digital_team_project p JOIN digital_team_project_member m ON m.project_id = p.business_id AND m.tenant_id = p.tenant_id WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE digital_team_project SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, coordinator_agent_id = #{coordinatorAgentId}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND business_id = #{projectId}
